parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of users displayed per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: SortType
parameters.description:
The sorting method. Valid values:

- 0: ascending order by time.

- 1: descending order by time.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The user-defined message type. The value must be greater than 10000.
